title: The Brood
summary: Raise the Brood: the Mother lays the eggs, grubs carry the food, rooted creatures are your buildings. Root a Mound Turtle and a Rootmaw on new ground, then a Sire, and hatch Raptors.
learn: The Brood Mother and her eggs
Mound Turtles: supply, swamp and new ground
The Sires: the fathers of your warriors

say: The Brood has no buildings, only creatures. Hear me, little one.
This is your Brood Mother, the heart of the swarm. If she dies, you lose.
Only she lays eggs. Pick a GRUB on her card: she lays its egg at once.
Grubs carry food from the Rootmaw to her. Food is your money: watch it on the top bar.
A new grub goes to work by itself when it hatches.
Room for more creatures is supply. She gives 16, and each ROOTED Mound Turtle 12 more.
A turtle also spreads swamp round it: new ground for your Rootmaws.

say.pc: Select a grub, press BUILD (B), pick the MOUND TURTLE and place it at the foot of your ramp.
say.phone: Select a grub, tap BUILD, pick the MOUND TURTLE and place it at the foot of your ramp.

steps.task: Root a Mound Turtle at the foot of the ramp.

say: The turtle's swamp is fresh ground. A Rootmaw rooted there drinks its food.
Turn a grub into a Rootmaw on that swamp. Farther from her, each trip pays more.
steps.task: Root a Rootmaw on the turtle's swamp.

say.pc: Send grubs to it: select some and right-click the new Rootmaw.
say.phone: Send grubs to it: select some and tap the new Rootmaw.

say: Keep two on each Rootmaw. Lay more grubs if you need them.
Your warriors need a father. A grub becomes the Tyrant Sire, the father of the Raptors.
Root him beside the Mother, inside the father range she shows.
steps.task: Root a Tyrant Sire beside the Mother.

say: Now select the Mother and lay a RAPTOR egg. The Sire breathes on it in his nest, and it hatches.
Rooted creatures are your buildings: they never fight. UPROOT gets one up to walk and bite.
GROW the Mother for more eggs, and guard her above all. Now try a practice game.

you.text: You laid eggs, rooted a Mound Turtle and a Rootmaw on new ground, rooted a Sire and hatched Raptors.
